description: Returns the content of one saved version of an ODocs.co document, by its index in list-versions. The default result is a plaintext view (frontmatter: timestamp, title, note; then the content); format:"json" returns { timestamp, title, content }; frontmatter:false returns just the content. The note (that the text is written by anyone with the link) is the frontmatter's note field in the text view; json and frontmatter:false results carry it as a second text item.

format.description: Response format: 'text' (default) is a readable .txt-style view; 'json' is the structured object.

frontmatter.description: (text format only) Include the metadata frontmatter block. Default true; false returns just the body.

index.description: Version index, as listed by list-versions

name: get-version
title: Get Document Version
